goal: Recover and genuinely exercise the real ProjectPulse Codex-assisted CGKN generation route, strengthen direct-CLI generation and repair boundaries, and prove candidate behavior without bypassing Provider review or delivery authority.
acceptance_criteria: A non-retryable Provider key-usage-limit response cannot consume the full plugin subprocess budget through repeated identical semantic attempts; the exact pending leaf checkpoint remains recoverable.

A recorded local fallback for component generation receives the configured bounded local-generation timeout instead of the shorter API request timeout, while API-owned calls retain their existing cap.

A valid sealed Codex brief is hash-bound to the generation plan and its concrete package, module, public-symbol, entrypoint, safety, and acceptance constraints are checked before Provider file generation.
No fix writes a sealed generated candidate, adds a generation path, changes the Telegram default route, packages output, or promotes support evidence to formal PASS.
Targeted timeout, Provider failure, capability-brief, goal-plan, plugin, kernel, and management regressions pass.
The ProjectPulse failure fixture rejects the observed backend/Note plan drift before source generation and accepts a plan that preserves the brief's projectpulse/Task/JSONRepository contract.

quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: canonical goal behaviors mapped to substantive executable tests and a real passing post-build test run

quality_metrics.measure: bounded Codex escalation usefulness and authority isolation
quality_metrics.target: a librarian-curated request and Codex response stay within configured budgets, preserve request identity, produce actionable guidance, and cannot assert formal evidence or delivery authority

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: The reviewed Provider mainline remains scripts/run_local_pipeline.py with the sealed brief and explicit confirmation; local fallback uses the same leaf contracts and validation chain.
A named direct-CLI candidate is not review-ready until its runtime leaves, pyproject installability, copyable README usage, substantive GoalSpec tests, and real pytest execution all pass.
Candidate-only PASS receipts never authorize packaging or delivery when Provider semantic review is transport-blocked.

The CGKN plugin MCP process receives the canonical CGKN_OPENAI_API_KEY and CGKN_OPENAI_BASE_URL variables after credential replacement and does not depend on a cleared OPENAI_API_KEY compatibility copy.

feedback: The same reviewed Provider route genuinely regenerated and repaired ProjectPulse. Candidate post-build and all 15 GoalSpec behaviors pass, the latest wheel installs in a clean venv, and both installed entry forms execute successfully.

Direct-CLI contracts now reject invalid packaging discovery, runtime-name placeholders, swallowed import errors, per-command Task serialization gaps, and non-copyable README examples; exact bounded repair prompts recovered each observed leaf without hand-editing the candidate.

Formal delivery remains unavailable: Provider semantic review is blocked by the external key-usage limit, overall status is ASK_USER_REVIEW, final_delivery_allowed is false, and no bundle or delivery manifest exists.

The post-replacement plugin startup gap was traced to an MCP manifest that forwarded only the cleared OPENAI_API_KEY compatibility variable. The source plugin now forwards the canonical key and base URL, guarded generation accepts the canonical process credential, plugin tests pass 7/7, kernel tests pass 31/31, and plugin validation passes.

worked: Whole-candidate direct-CLI revalidation caught defects that a shallow 15-test suite initially missed, while accepted-leaf revalidation avoided repeating successful model repairs.

Exact complete-source micro-repairs reduced repeated local-model failures for module-scope placeholders, malformed-import exception propagation, Task JSON serialization, and README invocation completion.
A clean wheel build and isolated install exposed and then verified the explicit setuptools package-discovery boundary.
did_not_work: Large generic local-model prompts repeatedly echoed invalid lines or omitted one required usage example; bounded exact repair envelopes were needed.
The official generated-project test tool correctly refused the candidate-only directory because Provider review never materialized a formal generated-project directory.
experiments: On a future run with available Provider quota, reuse the same artifact root and GoalSpec, obtain Provider semantic review, and verify that the unchanged local_packager/public_delivery_gate path alone produces formal delivery artifacts.
